area.description: Final v3: six independent held-out examples, four seconds each; all five panels visible simultaneously.

recognition.description: GT versus frozen ACSH predictions; two seconds of full field of view followed by four seconds of the same ROI per example.

area_titleless_frames.description: Lossless native v3 compositions rerendered from the original cached inputs with only the main title drawing call omitted; no inference or estimator changes.
area_titleless_frames.pixel_validation: Each native frame differs from its original only in 6,819 main-title glyph pixels, within x=[41,584), y=[38,72). All other pixels match exactly. The native header background is uniformly RGB(243,245,247).

provenance.model: Frozen paper ACSH (P2 + ACmix) instance segmenter
provenance.predictions: All predictions at or above the uniform display threshold are retained in the source overview; no GT-based prediction correction or suppression.
provenance.selection: Curated qualitative examples; the GIFs are not a representative accuracy or runtime benchmark.
provenance.temporal_scope: Sparse independent annotated images with fixed presentation holds; no continuous driving footage, tracking, interpolated source frames or inference-FPS claim.
provenance.area_definition: Bounding-box planimetric footprint from fisheye rectification and local road-plane intersection, followed by frozen training-only log calibration; not mask area, cavity surface area or volume.
provenance.reference: LiDAR-derived evaluation reference areas, not surveyed ground truth; used only for comparison.
provenance.plane_panel: Native rectified RGB projected onto the actual fitted road plane, predicted mask contour, unmodified SVD support points and projected-box outline; appearance projection, not cavity reconstruction.
provenance.depth_panel: Frozen monocular predicted metric depth, not GT depth; per-example finite-positive P2–P98 display scale, fixed within each example.
provenance.transforms: The README GIF and preview are exported directly from bundled lossless native frames. The original renderer was rerun with only the main-title drawing call omitted, retaining its original uniform background. Each example is held for four seconds, downscaled with Lanczos and palette-quantized for 10 fps GIF playback. All other native pixels, predictions, numbers, panels and counters are unchanged. Archived GIFs retain their original video extraction, frame sampling, scaling and quantization.
